purpose: Add optional game-like side activities that plausibly happen inside the time, place and character context of the Peter Jackson film story without creating an alternate main story.
canon_rule: The film spine is mandatory. Side activities are unseen gap-fill moments only: plausible things the player could have done between film anchors.
hard_rules: No side activity may replace, delay past plausibility, reorder, skip or change a mandatory film-story outcome.
No new major villain, faction, artifact, prophecy, romance, betrayal or world-changing event may be invented for side content.
Named characters may participate only when they are plausibly present and not locked in a conflicting film beat.
Side content may expand ordinary travel, preparation, friendship, observation, culture, survival and local life.
Future knowledge is forbidden. Dialogue and objectives use only what the character could know at that story point.
Rewards come from Journey Discoveries, Chronicle, dialogue/memory and navigation quality-of-life; no combat-stat inflation.
Urgent danger automatically suspends or cancels casual side activity and restores the mandatory route.
Failure in a side activity never changes canon; it only ends or restarts that optional activity.

activities.title: A Last Race Before the Road
activities.film_context: A harmless friendship moment during the still-safe Shire period before Bilbo's party turns the story.
mechanics: no hard fail; slower finish changes only banter

activities.title: Party Preparations
activities.film_context: The birthday celebration is already being prepared; the player helps with ordinary lantern, food and table errands without changing any film event.
mechanics: carry two or three lightweight props
choose a short route through market/garden life
activities.urgency_policy: Completes or silently expires when the party story anchor starts.

activities.title: Watch the Room
activities.film_context: Before the public Ring incident, the hobbits are strangers in a crowded inn and can notice local reactions without learning future events.
mechanics: identify which conversations are merely curious versus openly suspicious

activities.title: Stable Yard Signs
activities.film_context: Wet roads and a busy stable give the player small environmental clues that the road is unusually tense, without revealing the Nazgul attack outcome.
mechanics: return to the inn before story escalation

activities.title: Read the Trail
activities.film_context: Strider is guiding the hobbits through dangerous country; a short trail-reading lesson fits naturally into travel.
activities.urgency_policy: Ends when Weathertop becomes the immediate destination.

activities.title: Prepare the Camp
activities.film_context: The group pauses before the attack; the player can gather water, check gear and choose where supplies sit, but the attack still happens exactly as required.

activities.title: Paths on the Map
activities.film_context: During recovery and reunion, a quiet map-table activity can deepen the sense of place without deciding the Council's mission in advance.

activities.title: The Valley Overlook
activities.film_context: A short walk and reflective conversation between reunion and Council, using only memories and concerns already established.

activities.title: Camp Practice
activities.film_context: The Fellowship has a travel-camp period where light training and banter fit the film's companionship tone.

activities.title: Marks in the Stone
activities.film_context: While the company is stalled at the West Gate, the player can examine worn marks and stonework without solving or changing the mandatory door outcome.
mechanics: return to the main door interaction

activities.title: Follow the Echo
activities.film_context: Moria is vast, dark and uncertain; route-reading through echoes adds gameplay without inventing civilians or changing the required path.
mechanics: choose a side alcove that loops back to the Fellowship route
activities.urgency_policy: All optional routing locks once Balin's Tomb escalation begins.

activities.title: A Dwarven Relief
activities.film_context: A surviving carving gives Gimli a small cultural reaction before the Tomb reveal, without spoiling what happened to Balin.
mechanics: Gimli identifies only what he plausibly knows

activities.title: A Quiet Place
activities.film_context: The Fellowship is grieving after Moria; an optional quiet conversation gives the loss space without changing the required Galadriel/Mirror sequence.
mechanics: sit or stand in the clearing
activities.urgency_policy: Pauses when a mandatory Galadriel/Mirror beat starts.

activities.title: Ready the Boats
activities.film_context: The company is preparing to leave by river; checking supplies and boat balance is ordinary gap-fill that cannot alter the departure outcome.

activities.title: Read the River
activities.film_context: During river travel, the player can learn to read safe currents; the activity never changes the destination or film timing.

activities.title: Distance in the Camp
activities.film_context: The company is visibly strained at Amon Hen. The player may notice spacing, silence and mood without gaining knowledge of Boromir's next action.
mechanics: optional short check-in with one companion

activities.title: What Has Changed Below
activities.film_context: From captivity, Gandalf can observe the industrial transformation below without affecting the required escape.

activities.title: Old Counsel, Broken Trust
activities.film_context: A brief internal/reflection interaction can contrast the old alliance with the unease of the present without revealing Saruman's betrayal early.

reward_contract.rule: Side activities may award only the linked first-time discovery reward and bounded memory/dialogue/Chronicle effects.
reward_contract.repeat_policy: Replay is allowed only for fun/banter where appropriate; Journey Insight remains first-time-only.

runtime_next: Implement a lightweight side-activity trigger/state layer by extending existing quest/exploration owners rather than creating a competing story manager.
Use existing chapter builders and story-beat gates for availability.
Feed completion into JourneyDiscoveryRewardPlan and named-NPC memory/dialogue context.
Persist only compact optional completion IDs and reward state.
Add automation proving each side activity cannot mutate required story anchors.
runtime_progression_rule: A side-activity reward is applied only when its linked first-time Journey Discovery registers; repeating the activity/discovery cannot farm XP.
chronicle_map_rule: Every linked first-time discovery creates a film-continuity Chronicle entry and reveals the current route/chapter in map knowledge. Neither advances mandatory story.
